scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.seed.json
scripts.test: pnpm db:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js && tsx --test prisma/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: pnpm db:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test $NODE_TEST_FLAGS dist-test/test/colecoes.test.js dist-test/test/health.test.js dist-test/test/autenticacao.test.js dist-test/test/acesso.test.js dist-test/test/cadastro.test.js dist-test/test/odata.test.js dist-test/test/catalogo.test.js dist-test/test/auditoria.test.js dist-test/test/periodos.test.js dist-test/test/pesquisas.test.js && tsx --test $TSX_TEST_FLAGS prisma/demo-fixtures.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: node -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_TEST_URL) throw Error('DATABASE_TEST_URL é obrigatória para integração')" && pnpm db:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 $NODE_TEST_FLAGS dist-test/test/prisma.integration.test.js dist-test/test/autenticacao.integration.test.js dist-test/test/acesso.integration.test.js dist-test/test/cadastro.integration.test.js dist-test/test/odata.integration.test.js dist-test/test/odata-colecoes.integration.test.js dist-test/test/catalogo.integration.test.js dist-test/test/inventario.integration.test.js dist-test/test/auditoria.integration.test.js dist-test/test/periodos.integration.test.js dist-test/test/modelos.integration.test.js dist-test/test/edicoes.integration.test.js dist-test/test/respostas.integration.test.js && tsx --test $TSX_TEST_FLAGS prisma/demo-fixtures.integration.test.ts
